proposedSlice: Approved active unit-CI dispatch for the current task with an existing verified immutable candidate repository/full commit.
reuse: existing run authorization and task revision locks
existing real CI original receipts and stale/quality gates
missingTrustedSourceBehavior: Return a specific missing-source blocker and launch zero candidate containers; never infer HEAD, branch or a post-merge commit as the pre-CI binding.
approvalBoundary: Within an already approved unit-CI scope no per-CI approval is proposed; revocation and exact task/source binding remain required.
